name: AXM Asset Pack Lab
summary: Compatibility route for Publish & Library's pack and reusable-template view.
notes: The user-facing pack workflow opens inside Publish & Library and can still be used contextually from Studio. This compatibility route preserves existing links and data. It creates pack manifests and template-shell metadata and does not install packs automatically.
no_fake_done: Generated pack manifests are planning/export artifacts in v0.1.
Launcher auto-consumption of skin packs is not built yet.
Pack installation/copying is not built yet.
Visual editing remains in AXM Studio / Layer Forge, not this lab.
